AiAssistantProfile.description: **One assistant runtime, many profiles** (design 5.10, C5; AIC-069..080). The profile decides the audience, roles, knowledge sources, tools, model task and guest scope: guest concierge, support chatbot and staff assistants by role.

toolKeys.description: Registered tools it may propose (an assistant only reads; a change request goes to the configuration assistant, AIC-078).

modelTask.description: The gateway task, e.g. `assistant.staff.answer`. The visit planner agent (29 September, MOB-6) is profile `planner.guest` with task `planner.guest.refine` and the five `venue-map` visit-plan tools. The app publishing guide (M24-08) is profile `guide.appPublishing` with task `assistant.staff.answer`, grounded on the platform's store-publishing collection only.

guestCapabilityScope.description: For a guest profile: the same values as `AiPolicy.guestCapabilityScope`, narrowed.

handoverTarget.description: Where "ask a person" goes: a support queue or a staff role.

scopePath.description: **The partition key** (ADR-0005). Row-level security compares it with `ticvai.scope_paths` (`platform.apply_scope_rls`), on the tenant database and on the AI log database alike (design 3.1).

AiCustomerServiceCopilotKnowledgeWorkspa.description: The customer-service copilot's configuration for one scope (pack 10.1.10). A field left out takes its default, not its old value.

scopePath.description: **The partition key** (ADR-0005), and the upsert key: one row per scope.

dataSources.description: The authorised data the copilot may read, always within the asking agent's own permissions.

knowledgeCollectionIds.description: `ai.knowledge_collection` rows holding service procedures, product information, refund rules, ticket policies, venue instructions, FAQs and internal SOPs.

brandTone.description: Tone guidance applied to every draft.

autoSend.description: Channels where an approved automation may send without an agent. Empty means every customer-facing message waits for a person.

patternDetection.description: Flags a systemic problem when many cases share one cause.

AiCustomerServiceCopilotKnowledgeWorkspa.x-ticvai-persistence: none — projection over marketing.service_copilot_config (new), ai.policy and ai.knowledge_collection
AiCustomerServiceCopilotKnowledgeWorkspa.description: The stored configuration and what is in effect at that scope after the tenant row and the AI policy are applied.

effective.description: The narrowest of this row, its tenant row and `getAiPolicy`.

CaseCategory.description: **The venue's case taxonomy**: categories and, under them, subcategories (`parentCategoryId`). `Case.categoryId` and the routing rules' `match.categoryIds` point here; `createCaseClassificationIntelligent` recommends one. Maintained by `setCaseCategoryDefinition`, read by `listCaseCategories` (decided 29 September, writers pass). (decided 29 September, data model for the agreed operations)

parentCategoryId.description: Set on a subcategory; null on a top-level category.

defaultPriority.description: The priority a case in this category starts at before routing factors apply.

CaseCreationClassificationIntelligentRou.x-ticvai-persistence: none — request only; the case itself is raised with `createCase`
CaseCreationClassificationIntelligentRou.description: The case as the agent has captured it so far (pack 10.1.4 Case Creation). Every field maps onto `CreateCaseRequest` or onto a linked record.

categoryId.description: Where the agent has already chosen one.

CaseCreationClassificationIntelligentRou.x-ticvai-persistence: none — computed from marketing.case, marketing.sla_policy, marketing.agent_availability, marketing.case_category (new) and the routing rules; nothing is stored
CaseCreationClassificationIntelligentRou.description: The recommendation for one case. Every recommended value names why.

recommendedAssigneePrincipalId.description: The preview; null when nobody with the skill is available.

aiAssessment.description: Where the AI policy enables `assist`; AI-derived and labelled as such.

signals.description: e.g. ticket issue, upcoming event, high urgency.

duplicateCandidates.description: Open cases for the same customer and related records, best match first.

CaseInvestigationResolutionWorkspaceInpu.description: One link between a case and a record another contract owns. The reference is a pointer, never a copy.

referenceId.description: The record's id in its owning contract (orders, payments, access, wallet).

isActive.description: False unlinks; the row stays for the audit trail.

CaseInvestigationResolutionWorkspaceView.x-ticvai-persistence: none — projection over marketing.case, marketing.case_message, marketing.case_linked_record (new), marketing.sla_policy and ai.suggestion
CaseInvestigationResolutionWorkspaceView.description: The case workspace (pack 10.1.5). Recommended actions and the summary keep verified data, policy and AI recommendation apart.

customer.description: The guest's name, as `Case.guestName`; null unless the caller holds GUEST_VIEW_PII.

policyReference.description: The policy the action rests on; an AI recommendation never invents one.

aiSummary.description: Where the AI policy enables `summarise`; AI-derived and labelled as such.

CaseKind.description:
**What the guest says the case is about**, in their words rather than the venue's taxonomy — `raiseMyCase` asks for it and `categoryId` is what staff file it under. Stored on the case, because a lost-property report that forgets it was one cannot be routed to the lost and found desk.
**`other` only with a note (decided 28 September, audit R222).** A case raised as `other` must carry a non-empty `detail` (`raiseMyCase`), or it is refused with 400; the notes are reviewed quarterly to add the real kinds they reveal.

CaseResolutionClosureCustomerFeedbackVie.description: One case's resolution record (pack 10.1.9), with closure checks, feedback and reopen history computed on read from marketing.case, marketing.case_message, marketing.case_internal_request, marketing.case_compensation_request, approvals.request and marketing.form_submission.

financialImpact.description: Net money refunded or credited; zero when none.

compensationRequestIds.description: The case's compensation requests (`setRefundCompensationService`) this resolution relied on.

customerNotification.description: How the customer was told; the message itself is a `CaseMessage` or a `MessageDispatch`.

feedback.description: Null where no survey is configured for case resolution.

lastReopenReason.description: `reopenCase`'s reason; `refundFailed` when the system reopened it after a refund failed.

Customer360ServiceProfileView.x-ticvai-persistence: none — projection over marketing.guest_profile, pii.subject, pii.subject_contact, marketing.loyalty_position, marketing.guest_preference, marketing.consent_record, marketing.suppression, marketing.case, orders.sales_order, orders.reservation, orders.group_booking, access.entitlement and wallet.balance
Customer360ServiceProfileView.description: The service view of one guest. Fields the caller may not see are null, never omitted.

customerName.description: Null unless the caller holds GUEST_VIEW_PII.

contactDetails.description: Masked (e.g. `j***@example.com`, `+971 ** *** 4821`) unless the caller holds GUEST_VIEW_PII.

customerValue.description: Lifetime net spend across the tenant.

riskAttentionIndicator.description: `attention` with an open complaint or an unresolved refund case; `risk` with a breached SLA or a repeat contact on the same issue.

accessibilityRequirements.description: Null unless the caller holds GUEST_VIEW_PII.

communicationRestrictions.description: Channels the guest must not be contacted on (`getSuppressionList`).

aiSummary.description: Where the AI policy enables `summarise`. AI-derived and labelled as such.

CustomerServiceCommandCenterView.x-ticvai-persistence: none — projection over marketing.case, marketing.case_message, marketing.case_internal_request (new), marketing.case_compensation_request (new), marketing.sla_policy and approvals.request
CustomerServiceCommandCenterView.description: One agent's workload for the filters given. "Today" is the venue's local day. Counts are of cases assigned to the agent unless the name says otherwise.

newCases.description: Assigned to the agent and still `open` (not yet picked up).

slaAtRisk.description: Open, not breached, with less than 25% of the SLA window left.

awaitingInternalTeam.description: Open, with at least one open internal request.

averageResolutionSeconds.description: Mean of `resolvedAt - recordedAt - slaPausedSeconds` over the agent's cases resolved in the last 30 days; null when none.

workQueue.description: The agent's 50 most urgent open cases.

customer.description: The guest's name, resolved from `pii.subject` as `Case.guestName` is; null unless the caller holds GUEST_VIEW_PII.

aiPriorityRank.description: Where AI prioritisation is enabled (`getAiPolicy`), the case's rank in the queue.

aiPriorityFactors.description: What raised the rank; AI-derived and labelled as such on screen.

todaysTasks.description: Work due today derived from the agent's cases, earliest `dueAt` first.

referenceId.description: The internal request, compensation request or approval request behind it.

EscalationCollaborationInternalResolutio.description: One internal request from a case to a department (pack 10.1.8 Internal Request). The case keeps its owner; this is the department's piece of work.

id.description: Client-generated UUIDv7; equals the `Idempotency-Key` header on the write.

response.description: The department's answer; required to complete.

isOverdue.description: Computed on read; open or in progress past `dueAt`.

aiRecommendedDepartment.description: Where the AI policy enables `assist`; the department AI suggests from the case context.

OrderBookingTicketServiceWorkspaceInput.x-ticvai-record-definition: Permitted Service Actions (one per executed action)
OrderBookingTicketServiceWorkspaceInput.description: One service action on an order, taken from a case. Only an `execute` stores a row.

caseId.description: Required with `execute`; the action is recorded on this case.

targetPerformanceId.description: For `reschedule` and `exchange`, the option chosen from the evaluation.

recipientSubjectId.description: For `transfer` and `changeName`, the new ticket holder.

downstreamOperation.description: The operation that performed it, e.g. `rescheduleOrder`.

OrderBookingTicketServiceWorkspaceView.x-ticvai-persistence: none — projection over orders.sales_order, orders.order_line, orders.payment, access.entitlement, marketing.case_service_action (new) and the policies each owning operation reads
OrderBookingTicketServiceWorkspaceView.description: The order as a service agent sees it, what may be done to it, and what was done.

order.description: The order number shown to the guest.

channel.description: The sales channel the order came through.

lastAction.description: The action just executed; null on `evaluate`.

RefundCompensationServiceExceptionWorksp.description: One refund, compensation or policy-exception request raised from a case. The order, refund and approval are references, never copies.

value.description: The money value requested; for a complimentary ticket or upgrade, its face value. This is what the approval thresholds are compared with.

isPolicyException.description: True when the standard policy would not allow it; always needs approval.

submit.description: False saves a draft; true routes it.

fulfilmentReference.description: The refund, wallet transaction or voucher it produced.

RefundCompensationServiceExceptionWorksp.x-ticvai-persistence: none — projection over marketing.case_compensation_request (new), orders.sales_order, orders.refund, orders.order_fee, orders.refund_policy and approvals.request
RefundCompensationServiceExceptionWorksp.description: The request, the order's financial context, the policy evaluation and who must approve.

amountUsed.description: Value of tickets already scanned or consumed.

refundableAmount.description: What the refund policy's time bands allow now, less previous refunds.

standardPolicy.description: The rule that applies, as the venue's refund policy states it.

approvalLevel.description: From the venue's `selfAuthoriseLimit`, `requiresSecondUserAbove` and `requiresApprovalAbove`; a policy exception is always `approver`.

aiExplanation.description: AI-derived and labelled as such; cites a recorded policy or says none applies.

UnifiedInteractionCommunicationHistoryVi.x-ticvai-persistence: none — projection over marketing.case_message, marketing.conversation_message, marketing.conversation (telephony), marketing.message_dispatch and marketing.kiosk_assist_session
UnifiedInteractionCommunicationHistoryVi.description: One interaction on the timeline. `social` and `whatsapp` appear only where that channel is integrated.

id.description: Stable across pages; the source and record id combined.

subjectId.description: The guest; the name is resolved on screen through `getGuestProfile` under GUEST_VIEW_PII.

sentiment.description: Where sentiment analysis is enabled; AI-derived.

recordId.description: The row in the source table.
